server.description: IRC server connection details: hostname, port, optional SSL, server password (if required), and NickServ password (if using services).

host.description: IRC server hostname or IP address.

port.description: IRC server port (6667 for plaintext, 6697 or 7000 for SSL).

ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the connection.

password.description: Password for server authentication (e.g., SASL or server-specific login). Leave blank if not required.

nickserv_password.description: Password for NickServ identification (used to recover/claim nickname).

bot.description: Bot’s identity on IRC: nickname, username, real name, and optional virtual hostname.

nick.description: Primary nickname for the bot (must be available or fallback used).

user.description: Username (IDENT) the bot sends to the server.

vhost.description: Optional virtual hostname to request from the server (e.g., for cloaking).

channels.description: List of channels the bot will join on startup. Each entry must include a channel name; key is optional (for password-protected channels).

key.description: Channel key (password), if required. Leave blank if not needed.

admin.description: Enable admin interface and define authorized users (in format nick!user@host or just nick).

enabled.description: Enable the built-in admin plugin (allows remote control via private messages or channels).

items.description: Full hostmask or nick pattern of authorized admin(s). Use wildcards (e.g., *!~user@*) to allow broader access.

users.description: List of users allowed to use admin commands (e.g., reload, shutdown).

log.description: Enable and configure logging of bot activity and channel messages.

enabled.description: Enable logging of messages and commands.

path.description: Directory where logs are stored. Ensure the bot process has write permissions.

format.description: Log format: 'json', 'text', or 'csv'. JSON is recommended for structured analysis.

plugin.description: Select which built-in plugins to enable or disable at startup.

enabled.description: List of plugin names to load. Omit to disable a plugin.

disabled.description: List of built-in plugins to explicitly disable (e.g., 'Admin' if you prefer CLI-only control).

prefix.description: Command prefix for bot commands in channels (e.g., !help, !uptime). Avoid special characters that may interfere with IRC formatting.

timeout.description: Connection and read timeouts in seconds.

connect.description: Maximum seconds to wait for connection to IRC server before retry/failure.

read.description: Maximum seconds of inactivity before reconnecting (0 = no timeout).

nick_fallback.description: Fallback nickname to use if the primary nick is already in use. Should differ slightly (e.g., appended underscore or digit).
